adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the new DB fallback sets `calendarCredential` to the raw result of `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` without including the related `app` or constructing an `appName`. In contrast, the parallel logic added in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` explicitly `include`s `app: { select: { slug: true } }` and builds a `CredentialWithAppName` object. Since `handleCancelBooking.ts` then passes this potentially incomplete `calendarCredential` into `getCalendar(...)`, this fallback path can break calendar resolution when the credential isn’t present in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`.
